text: 3-year-old child. The parents report that the child appears unwell and has been breathing rapidly. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure. Based on the triad of rapid breathing, pitting edema, and hepatomegaly in a previously well 3-year-old, these findings are highly suggestive of heart failure. REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
